sources.quote: Compact at milestones. After you finish a logical chunk, run /compact Preserve the decisions made, files changed, and test commands.
sources.author: Arpan Patel

definition.en: The practice in which several agents or models work on the same problem at the same time, each with its own approach, and the developer compares the results. [1][2][3]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой несколько агентов или моделей одновременно работают над одной задачей, каждый своим подходом, а разработчик сравнивает результаты. [1][2][3]

sources.quote: Another researcher explained that they ran many versions of Claude simultaneously, all exploring different approaches to a problem:
sources.author: Saffron Huang, Bryan Seethor, Esin Durmus, Kunal Handa, Miles McCain, Michael Stern, Deep Ganguli

sources.quote: We've found that having multiple models attempt the same problem and picking the best result significantly improves the final output, especially for harder tasks.
sources.author: Lee Robinson

sources.quote: Instead of dividing the work, have agents compete on it. Spawn N agents that each attempt the same task using different approaches.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar and Sid Bidasaria

definition.en: The practice in which the application can be started separately in each git worktree, so that every agent runs and checks its own instance. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой приложение запускается отдельно в каждом git worktree, и каждый агент запускает и проверяет свой экземпляр. [1]

sources.quote: For example, we made the app bootable per git worktree, so Codex could launch and drive one instance per change.
sources.author: Ryan Lopopolo

title.en: Vulnerability hunting agents with test proof
title.ru: Поиск уязвимостей агентами с доказательством тестом

definition.en: The practice in which agents search parts of an application for one category of vulnerability, a separate verifier agent proves each finding with a test in the application's own test suite, and findings arrive as pull requests. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой агенты ищут в частях приложения уязвимости одной категории, отдельный агент-проверяющий доказывает каждую находку тестом в наборе тестов самого приложения, а находки приходят как pull request. [1]

sources.quote: Our Verifier agent is tasked with authoring and embedding its validations into the existing tests and primitives available in that app.
sources.author: Zack Deveau

title.en: Vertical slices in agent work plans

definition.en: The practice in which the agent's work plan for a feature is cut into vertical slices that cross backend and frontend, so that integration is exercised before the end of the work. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой план работы агента над фичей режут на вертикальные срезы через бэкенд и фронтенд, чтобы интеграция проверялась до конца работы. [1][2]

sources.quote: Backend and frontend design stay separate, a consistency check covers the boundary between them, and the work plan uses vertical slices so integration is exercised before the end.
sources.author: shinpr

sources.quote: And in most cases, I'll send off a model to do 1-3 slices at a time, and review the code as I go. It's a lot easier to resteer early on, whether it's the internals or the actual functionality, than to end up on the other side of 2k+ lines of code with no idea what's broken.
sources.author: Dex

definition.en: The practice in which contributors state in the pull request, commit message or post whether and how a model or agent produced the content. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой участники указывают в pull request, коммите или сообщении, создавали ли содержимое модель или агент и как. [1][2]

sources.quote: Contributors should note tool usage in their pull request description, commit message, or wherever authorship is normally indicated for the work.
sources.author: rnk

sources.quote: You must disclose LLM-generated content. You can choose to not post LLM content, or you can choose to post it and disclose its origin.
sources.author: Jynn Nelson

definition.en: The practice in which a project requires contributors to read and review all generated code or text, and to be able to explain it, before they ask maintainers for review. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой проект требует от авторов вкладов прочитать и проверить весь сгенерированный код или текст и уметь его объяснить, прежде чем просить ревью у мейнтейнеров. [1][2]

sources.quote: Contributors must read and review all LLM-generated code or text before they ask other project members to review it.
sources.author: rnk

sources.quote: LLM reviews cannot substitute for human review or self-review.
sources.author: Jynn Nelson

title.ru: Свои слова в общении в проекте

definition.en: The practice in which a project requires issues, pull request descriptions, comments and replies to review to be written in the contributor's own words, not pasted model output. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой проект требует, чтобы issues, описания pull request, комментарии и ответы на ревью были написаны своими словами автора, а не вставленным выводом модели. [1][2]

sources.quote: Passing maintainer feedback to an LLM doesn’t help anyone grow, and does not sustain our community.
sources.author: rnk

sources.quote: In short, if you are posting any of those things, the output must be your own words, explanation, description, etc., not a verbatim dump of an LLM's output.
sources.author: Jellyfin project

title.en: Agents in project spaces only with approval
title.ru: Агенты в пространствах проекта только с одобрения

definition.en: The practice in which an agent may comment on or act in shared project spaces only after people approve it or explicitly invoke it. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой агент может комментировать или действовать в общих пространствах проекта только после одобрения людьми или по явному вызову. [1][2]

sources.quote: An important implication of this policy is that it bans agents that take action in our digital spaces without human approval, such as the GitHub @claude agent.
sources.author: rnk

sources.quote: This skill requires explicit invocation because it can comment, label, or close another person's contribution.
sources.author: Wirasm

definition.en: The practice in which maintainers who judge a generated contribution to cost more review time than it is worth reply with a standard request, label it, and stop engaging or close it. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой мейнтейнеры, решив, что сгенерированный вклад отнимает на ревью больше времени, чем стоит, отвечают стандартной просьбой, ставят метку и прекращают обсуждение или закрывают вклад. [1][2]

sources.quote: Other reviewers should use the label to prioritize their review time.
sources.author: rnk

sources.quote: You are allowed to close PRs that don't follow the policy, no questions asked. Please point the author to #llm-mentoring at the same time.
sources.author: Jynn Nelson

definition.en: The practice in which a project does not accept contributions that include content generated, in part or in full, by language models or similar systems. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой проект не принимает вклады, содержащие материал, созданный целиком или частично языковыми моделями или похожими системами. [1]

sources.quote: Contributions in the OpenJDK Community must not include content generated, in part or in full, by large language models, diffusion models, or similar deep-learning systems.
sources.author: OpenJDK Governing Board

definition.en: The practice in which a project lets contributors use language models to answer questions, analyze, check and review their work, but not to create the content they submit. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой проект разрешает участникам использовать языковые модели, чтобы отвечать на вопросы, анализировать, проверять и ревьюить свою работу, но не создавать то, что они присылают. [1]

sources.quote: LLMs must not generate soundness-critical changes unless the author is already a domain expert, and even then it's strongly discouraged.
sources.author: Jynn Nelson

definition.en: The practice in which shared agent controls used by many teams, such as skills, commands and root-level instruction files, have an owning team or guild that watches monitoring data and updates them. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой у общих настроек агентов для многих команд, таких как скиллы, команды и корневые файлы инструкций, есть команда или гильдия-владелец, которая следит за данными мониторинга и обновляет их. [1]

sources.quote: On the other hand, more complex controls like skills, commands, or root-level documentation may be owned by entire teams or guilds.
sources.author: Addie Beach, Rui Martins Lacerda

title.ru: Вопросы об агентах в разборе инцидентов

definition.en: The practice in which a team's regular incident retrospective adds two questions: whether agent-written code contributed to the incident, and whether the larger volume of change strained review, testing, rollout or observability. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой в регулярный разбор инцидентов команды добавляют два вопроса: повлиял ли на инцидент код, написанный агентом, и не перегрузил ли возросший объём изменений ревью, тестирование, выкатку или наблюдаемость. [1]

sources.quote: During our AI ramp-up, we began asking two additional questions: Did AI-authored code directly contribute to the incident? And did the increased volume of change put additional pressure on review, testing, rollout, or observability?
sources.author: Tyson Singer

title.en: Extra approval for agent pull requests
title.ru: Повышенная планка для pull request агента

definition.en: The practice in which pull requests started by an agent or generated by a model must clear a higher bar than other pull requests, such as more human approvals or required tests. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой pull request, начатые агентом или созданные моделью, должны пройти более высокую планку, чем остальные: больше одобрений людей или обязательные тесты. [1][2]

sources.quote: We’ve settled on 2 human approvals for any AI-initiated PR for now, but it is kind of a weird paradigm shift (for me at least) when it’s no longer a human making something for another human to review.
sources.author: Shrivu Shankar

sources.quote: LLM PRs are required to have tests, full stop, regardless of how hard that is, as well as various other restrictions;
sources.author: Jynn Nelson

definition.en: The practice in which an engineer now and then solves a problem without an agent, even one the agent could solve, to keep their own skills. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой инженер время от времени решает задачу без агента, даже если агент бы с ней справился, чтобы сохранить свои навыки. [1]

sources.quote: To combat this, some engineers deliberately practice without AI: "Every once in a while, even if I know that Claude can nail a problem, I will not ask it to. It helps me keep myself sharp."
sources.author: Saffron Huang, Bryan Seethor, Esin Durmus, Kunal Handa, Miles McCain, Michael Stern, Deep Ganguli

definition.en: The practice in which an interview gives the candidate a few hours to build a working prototype with coding agents and tools of their choice. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой на собеседовании кандидату дают несколько часов, чтобы собрать работающий прототип с агентами и инструментами на свой выбор. [1][2]

sources.quote: After that, the candidate gets two hours to build a working prototype of the system they just designed using any AI model they want, and any frameworks.
sources.author: Applied Intuition

sources.quote: The centerpiece of our on-site was a three-hour build session. Candidates chose from a short list of assigned prompts and were asked to design, build, and deploy a working prototype on DigitalOcean by the end of the session.
sources.author: DigitalOcean

title.en: Assessing how a candidate directs agents
title.ru: Оценка того, как кандидат направляет агента

definition.en: The practice in which interviewers score how a candidate plans the work, steers the agent and checks what it produced. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой интервьюеры оценивают, как кандидат планирует работу, направляет агента и проверяет результат. [1][2]

sources.quote: Steering, not just prompting. Are you thinking about the how and why of the work, or just feeding the spec to an agent and hoping for the best?
sources.author: Elicit

sources.quote: Can they effectively direct and validate AI-generated work?
sources.author: Augment Code

title.en: Candidate's own agents in the interview

definition.en: The practice in which a candidate may use their own coding agents and tools during an interview, the same ones they would use at work. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой кандидат может пользоваться на собеседовании своими агентами и инструментами, теми же, что и на работе. [1][2]

sources.quote: The interviews where we want you to use AI tend to be deeper technical sessions. You’re on your own machine, using whatever tools you’re comfortable with.
sources.author: Elicit

sources.quote: We’re open to any type of tools, from none at all, to autocompletes, to full coding agents.
sources.author: Omnea

title.en: Review of a draft change in the interview

definition.en: The practice in which a candidate reviews and improves a colleague's draft pull request in an unfamiliar codebase, with agents allowed. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой кандидат на собеседовании проверяет и дорабатывает черновой pull request коллеги в незнакомой кодовой базе, с агентами. [1]

sources.quote: Candidates are given a medium-sized codebase and a draft PR from a colleague that introduces a cross-cutting feature. Their job is to review and improve it — pulling down the code, inspecting the output, and iterating with coding agents to make it better.
sources.author: Sierra

definition.en: The practice in which some interviews are deliberately held without agents, next to interviews where agents are expected. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой часть собеседований намеренно проводят без агентов, рядом с теми, где агенты ожидаются. [1]

sources.quote: There are some interviews where we explicitly ask candidates not to use AI.
sources.author: Elicit

title.en: Regular audit of the agent setup

definition.en: The practice in which, every few weeks, the developer audits the agent setup, including skills, plugins, instruction files and memory, with the tool's check command and reviews which parts still hold true. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой разработчик раз в несколько недель проверяет настройку агента, включая скиллы, плагины, файлы инструкций и память, командой проверки инструмента и пересматривает, что из этого ещё верно. [1]

sources.quote: And so I think there’s high value personally in, like maybe every couple of weeks, maybe at once a month even, just running doctor on your skills, on your setup, and auditing what you’re doing and seeing, okay, well, what still holds true?
sources.author: Addy Osmani

definition.en: The practice in which tests are kept as data files with the input, the expected output and the setup, read by a small test runner, so that agent changes to the tests are visible and can be blocked. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой тесты хранятся как файлы данных со входом, ожидаемым результатом и подготовкой, а читает их небольшой тестовый раннер, чтобы правки агента в тестах были видны и их можно было запретить. [1]

sources.quote: The tests are a contract that establishes what the code should do for us, and moving tests to data files, interpreted by a relatively smaller test runner, makes them easier to protect from unexpected manipulation by AI.
sources.author: Matteo Vaccari

definition.en: The practice in which faults are injected into production code, by hand, by the agent or by a library in CI, to check that tests written by an agent break with a clear error message. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой в продакшен-код вносят намеренные ошибки, вручную, руками агента или библиотекой в CI, и проверяют, что тесты, написанные агентом, падают с понятным сообщением об ошибке. [1]

sources.quote: The first thing we can do is mutation testing: we inject intentional faults in production code, and see if any test breaks, and if it breaks, check that the error message is correct and informative.
sources.author: Matteo Vaccari

definition.en: The practice in which test files and expected results that a task should not change are protected from the agent: made read-only, checked in CI for changes, or named in the agent's instructions as inputs to keep. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой файлы тестов и ожидаемые результаты, которые задача не должна менять, защищают от агента: делают доступными только для чтения, проверяют на изменения в CI или указывают в инструкциях агента как неизменяемые. [1][2]

sources.quote: Depending on the type of task, it’s possible to protect the files that we’re not expecting the AI to change, by making them read-only in a way that the agent cannot bypass, or by running a check in CI that verifies what files were changed depending on the type of task.
sources.author: Matteo Vaccari

sources.quote: The agent was instructed to preserve those inputs and the skill’s verification helpers, investigate failures, and correct the implementation or execution setup rather than weaken the expectations.
sources.author: Naresh Jain

definition.en: The practice in which, for medium- and high-risk pull requests, an agent guides the engineer through how the change affects the system, with understanding of the change, not approval, as the goal. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой для pull request среднего и высокого риска агент проводит инженера по тому, как изменение влияет на систему, и цель — понимание изменения, а не одобрение. [1]

sources.quote: We’ve been experimenting with a new process called Intent Review. For medium and high risk PRs, the agent guides the engineer through understanding how the change affects the system.
sources.author: Vinay Perneti and Emma Webb

definition.en: The practice in which agents read the codebase, issues, pull requests and discussion threads and write a knowledge base of unrecorded decisions and conventions, which other agents use when they work on the code. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой агенты читают код, issues, pull request и обсуждения и пишут базу знаний о незаписанных решениях и соглашениях, которой другие агенты пользуются, когда работают с кодом. [1]

sources.quote: Agents that crawl the codebase, the issues, the PRs, the threads, and produce a knowledge base of the implicit decisions, the conventions, the why-we-did-it-this-way that nobody had time to document.
sources.author: .txt

title.ru: Управление агентом на самом узком уровне

definition.en: The practice in which a team corrects an agent behavior with the control of the smallest scope that still gives the wanted output: first interface and output contracts, then automated checks, then skills or commands, and root instruction files last. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой команда исправляет поведение агента средством самого узкого охвата, которое ещё даёт нужный результат: сначала контракты интерфейса и вывода, затем автоматические проверки, затем скиллы или команды и в последнюю очередь корневые файлы инструкций. [1]

sources.quote: At Datadog, we aim to use the control with the smallest scope that still gives us the output we want.
sources.author: Addie Beach, Rui Martins Lacerda

title.en: Volunteer-only review of model-written pull requests
title.ru: Ревью pull request от модели только добровольцами

definition.en: The practice in which a project assigns pull requests written with a language model only to reviewers who volunteer for them, and such a reviewer may ask the author to redo the change without generated code. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой проект отдаёт pull request, написанные с помощью языковой модели, только тем ревьюерам, кто вызвался их проверять, и такой ревьюер может попросить автора переделать изменение без сгенерированного кода. [1]

sources.quote: No one is required to review LLM PRs unless they volunteer.
sources.author: Jynn Nelson

definition.en: The practice in which each benchmark an agent optimizes also runs in CI as a guardrail whose threshold may only move in one direction, and benchmarks that are flaky or do not track the real metric are dropped. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой каждый бенчмарк, который оптимизирует агент, также работает в CI как ограничитель с порогом, который может сдвигаться только в одну сторону, а нестабильные или не отражающие реальную метрику бенчмарки убираются. [1][2]

sources.quote: Each one had two jobs: first, a metric Claude could move in the lab; second, a guardrail in CI with a number that could only ratchet down.
sources.author: Raymond Wang, Sam Attard, and Issac G.

sources.quote: If a benchmark was flaky, or if it didn’t actually correlate with user latency, we threw it out rather than let Claude climb the wrong hill.
sources.author: Raymond Wang, Sam Attard, and Issac G.

definition.en: The practice in which an agent is given a measured number to beat and repeatedly changes the code and re-measures until the number improves. [1][2][3]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой агенту дают измеряемое число, которое надо улучшить, и он раз за разом меняет код и перемеряет, пока число не улучшится. [1][2][3]

sources.quote: As soon as Claude had a number to beat, it could start optimizing.
sources.author: Raymond Wang, Sam Attard, and Issac G.

sources.quote: Agents yearn for tight feedback loops. They allow them to hill-climb to their heart's content.
sources.author: sankalp

sources.quote: So we defined what healthy meant, instrumented the surface to answer it, and ran the whole change → measure → improve loop unattended.
sources.author: Alberto Gimeno

definition.en: The practice in which several agents look for bugs in a change at the same time, a separate group of agents votes on each finding, and only findings with enough votes are posted. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой несколько агентов одновременно ищут ошибки в изменении, отдельная группа агентов голосует по каждой находке, и публикуются только находки, набравшие достаточно голосов. [1]

sources.quote: Several agents look for bugs at the same time. Then a separate group votes on each finding, and it only gets posted if enough of them agree it's real.
sources.author: Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang

definition.en: A team rule in which every finding of the review agent must be fixed or resolved with a stated reason, and a pull request cannot merge while a bug or security finding is open. [1][2]
definition.ru: Командное правило, при котором каждую находку агента-ревьюера нужно исправить или закрыть с указанием причины, а пул-реквест нельзя слить, пока открыта находка об ошибке или безопасности. [1][2]

sources.quote: Every finding has to be answered. You either fix it or resolve the thread with a reason.
sources.author: Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang

sources.quote: A PR can't merge while any finding from the bug review or the security review is still open.
sources.author: Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang

definition.en: A team rule in which the person who directed the agent counts as one of the required reviewers of its pull request, and an agent's approval never counts as a person's. [1][2]
definition.ru: Командное правило, при котором человек, направлявший агента, считается одним из обязательных ревьюеров его пул-реквеста, а одобрение агента никогда не засчитывается как одобрение человека. [1][2]

sources.quote: Whoever prompted the change is on the hook for it. On an agent-written PR, the person directing the agent counts as one of the required reviewers, the same as if they'd typed the code themselves.
sources.author: Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang

sources.quote: An agent's approval never counts as a person's, either.
sources.author: Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang

definition.en: A team rule in which a review approval covers one specific commit, and new commits the system cannot vouch for, such as an agent's push or a hand-resolved merge, require approval again. [1]
definition.ru: Командное правило, при котором одобрение ревью относится к одному конкретному коммиту, а новые коммиты, за которые система не ручается, например пуш агента или слияние, разрешённое вручную, требуют повторного одобрения. [1]

sources.quote: An approval covers one specific commit. If new commits land that the system can't vouch for, like an agent's push or a merge someone resolved by hand, the approval has to be given again.
sources.author: Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang

definition.en: The practice in which agents that read untrusted content, such as public issues or messages, are barred from high-privilege actions, and those actions are done by separate agents. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой агентам, читающим недоверенный контент, например публичные задачи или сообщения, запрещены действия с высокими правами, а такие действия выполняют отдельные агенты. [1][2]

sources.quote: This involves barring the agents that read untrusted public content from taking high-privilege actions, which are instead done by the agents in charge of acting on the information.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar and Sid Bidasaria

sources.quote: The agent reads messages and issues that other people wrote, and that text can be interpreted as instructions. Limit what the agent could do if it followed them.
sources.author: Lance Martin and CJ Avilla

definition.en: The practice in which parallel agents take work from a shared list, and an agent claims a task, for example by writing a lock file, before working on it, so that no two agents take the same task. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой параллельные агенты берут работу из общего списка, и агент занимает задачу, например записывая файл-блокировку, прежде чем работать над ней, чтобы двое не взяли одно и то же. [1][2]

sources.quote: Claude takes a "lock" on a task by writing a text file to current_tasks/ (e.g., one agent might lock current_tasks/parse_if_statement.txt, while another locks current_tasks/codegen_function_definition.txt).
sources.author: Nicholas Carlini

sources.quote: Subtasks: A to-do list where any agent can add a task and the first helper to claim it owns it.
sources.author: Barry Zhang, Tianyi Peng, Elle Najt, Keller Scholl, and Lance Martin

definition.en: The practice in which a harness runs the agent in a loop: when one task finishes, the next run starts, until a stop condition such as no new findings or no errors is met. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой обвязка запускает агента в цикле: когда одна задача закончена, начинается следующий прогон, пока не выполнено условие остановки, например нет новых находок или ошибок. [1][2]

sources.quote: To elicit sustained, autonomous progress, I built a harness that sticks Claude in a simple loop (if you’ve seen Ralph-loop, this should look familiar). When it finishes one task, it immediately picks up the next.
sources.author: Nicholas Carlini

sources.quote: For tasks with an unknown amount of work, loop spawning agents until a stop condition is met (no new findings, or no more errors in the logs) instead of a fixed number of passes.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar and Sid Bidasaria

definition.en: The practice in which test and CI output is kept short and fast for the agent: a few lines on screen, details written to a log file, progress printed rarely. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой вывод тестов и CI делается коротким и быстрым для агента: несколько строк на экране, подробности в лог-файле, прогресс печатается редко. [1][2]

sources.quote: The test harness should not print thousands of useless bytes. At most, it should print a few lines of output and log all important information to a file so Claude can find it when needed.
sources.author: Nicholas Carlini

sources.quote: Two things have to be true for CI to function as part of an agent’s feedback loop. It has to be fast, and it has to be AI-legible.
sources.author: Liz Fong-Jones

definition.en: The practice in which the output of agent-written code is compared against an existing known-good implementation, which also narrows down which part of the agent's code is at fault. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой результат кода, написанного агентом, сравнивают с существующей заведомо верной реализацией, что также помогает найти, какая часть кода агента виновата. [1][2]

sources.quote: The fix was to use GCC as an online known-good compiler oracle to compare against. I wrote a new test harness that randomly compiled most of the kernel using GCC, and only the remaining files with Claude’s C Compiler.
sources.author: Nicholas Carlini

sources.quote: Automated comparison tests validated behavioral parity between legacy endpoints and migrated APIs.
sources.author: Aditya Sharma and Mahesh Kharade

definition.en: The practice in which a list of rules or claims is checked by separate verifier agents, one for each rule or claim. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой список правил или утверждений проверяют отдельные агенты-проверяющие, по одному на каждое правило или утверждение. [1][2]

sources.quote: If you have a particular set of rules that you find Claude misses or struggles with, even when put into the CLAUDE.mds, create a workflow with a list of rules that must be checked by verifier agents—one verifier per rule.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar and Sid Bidasaria

sources.quote: On the other hand, if you have a report where you want to check and source every factual claim that it references you may want to generate a workflow which has one agent identify all of the factual claims and then spin off a subagent to check each one in-detail.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar and Sid Bidasaria

definition.en: The practice in which several agents form hypotheses about a bug from separate, non-overlapping pieces of evidence, so that one early guess does not shape the whole investigation. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой несколько агентов строят гипотезы об ошибке по отдельным, непересекающимся частям данных, чтобы одна ранняя догадка не определяла всё расследование. [1]

sources.quote: A workflow can structurally prevent this by spinning up agents to generate hypotheses from disjoint evidence.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar and Sid Bidasaria

definition.en: The practice in which the agent writes plans, explanations and code reviews as HTML pages instead of Markdown documents. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой агент пишет планы, объяснения и разбор кода в виде HTML-страниц вместо документов Markdown. [1][2]

sources.quote: I’ve started preferring HTML as an output format instead of Markdown and increasingly see this pattern being applied by others on the Claude Code team.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar

sources.quote: Use HTML to understand code that the agent has written, to review code, or to explain a PR to someone reviewing your code.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar

definition.en: The practice in which the agent builds a disposable interface for editing something by hand, and the interface ends with an export button that turns the edits into a prompt or a file. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой агент делает одноразовый интерфейс для ручного редактирования, и этот интерфейс завершается кнопкой экспорта, превращающей правки в промпт или файл. [1]

sources.quote: The trick is always to end with an export: a "copy as JSON" or "copy as prompt" button that turns whatever I did in the UI back into something I can paste into Claude Code or commit to a file.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar

definition.en: The practice in which, before the agent writes code, the author walks the future pull request reviewer through the product and technical specs. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой до того, как агент напишет код, автор проходит продуктовую и техническую спецификацию с будущим ревьюером пул-реквеста. [1]

sources.quote: If you wanna save time during review, you pick the person who would review the PR, and run through the product/tech specs with them before you get to the coding part
sources.author: Dex

definition.en: The practice in which agents log every attempted idea and its result, and later agent sessions read the log to see whether an idea was already tried. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой агенты записывают каждую опробованную идею и её результат, а следующие сессии агентов читают журнал, чтобы понять, пробовали ли идею раньше. [1]

sources.quote: Logs serve as the evidence of the ideas that worked and didn't work. Future agent sessions could read the logs and quickly check if an idea had been tried or not.
sources.author: sankalp

definition.en: The practice in which an agent puts its own changes behind feature flags for gradual rollout and reads the flag's results as feedback on whether the change does what it claimed. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой агент сам закрывает свои изменения флагами функций для постепенного выката и использует результаты флага как обратную связь о том, делает ли изменение заявленное. [1]

sources.quote: The new angle is that agents can be given the ability to gate their own changes for gradual rollout; the flag itself becomes the feedback signal for whether the change is doing what it claimed.
sources.author: Liz Fong-Jones

title.en: Named owner of an agent thread

definition.en: A team rule in which every line of agent work has a named person who owns it, and the agent shows user-visible changes to that person with before-and-after screenshots or recordings. [1]
definition.ru: Командное правило, при котором у каждой линии работы агента есть названный ответственный человек, и агент показывает ему видимые пользователю изменения со скриншотами или записями до и после. [1]

sources.quote: Every thread had a named human owner, and Claude highlighted any user-perceptible change with before-and-after screenshots or recordings for them to rule on.
sources.author: Raymond Wang, Sam Attard, and Issac G.

definition.en: The practice in which each task for the agent is written as a self-contained ticket stating what is wrong, what done looks like and which command proves it. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой каждая задача для агента записывается как самодостаточный тикет: что не так, как выглядит готовность и какая команда это доказывает. [1][2]

sources.quote: Write each task as a self-contained ticket that states what's wrong, what done looks like, and how to prove it.
sources.author: Addy Osmani

sources.quote: Ask for evidence. Name the command that proves the task is done, and read Claude's summary before the diff.
sources.author: Addy Osmani

definition.en: A prompting habit in which the agent is told to take more risks and try more ambitious ideas. [1][2]
definition.ru: Приём промптинга, при котором агенту говорят больше рисковать и пробовать более амбициозные идеи. [1][2]

sources.quote: A lot of what we did, especially early on, was to encourage Claude to be bolder.
sources.author: Raymond Wang, Sam Attard, and Issac G.

sources.quote: Encourage the model to take more risks and try ambitious ideas. You will not believe it but this worked.
sources.author: sankalp

definition.en: The practice in which agent instructions, in a skill or the project instruction file, keep a section of gotchas built from the failure points the agent actually hit, updated over time. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой инструкции агента, в скилле или в файле инструкций проекта, содержат раздел подвохов, собранный из реальных мест, где агент ошибался, и пополняемый со временем. [1][2]

sources.quote: These sections should be built up from common failure points that Claude runs into when using your skill. Ideally, you will update your skill over time to capture these gotchas.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar

sources.quote: Keep your CLAUDE.md lightweight and briefly describe what your repo is for, but spend most of the tokens on gotchas inside of the codebase.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar

definition.en: The practice in which agent context is split into a tree of files, and the agent is told which files exist so that it reads each one only when it becomes relevant. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой контекст агента разбит на дерево файлов, и агенту сообщают, какие файлы есть, чтобы он читал каждый только тогда, когда он становится нужен. [1][2]

sources.quote: Instead, consider having a tree of files that can be loaded at the right time.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar

sources.quote: Tell Claude what files are in your skill, and it will read them at appropriate times.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar

definition.en: The practice in which constraints added to agent instructions for earlier, weaker models are reviewed and deleted, leaving the agent to rely on context and judgement. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой ограничения, добавленные в инструкции агента ради прежних, более слабых моделей, пересматривают и удаляют, оставляя агенту опираться на контекст и суждение. [1]

sources.quote: And while these constraints were once needed to avoid worst case scenarios, we have since found we can delete many of them and let the model use surrounding context and judgement instead.
sources.author: Thariq Shihipar

definition.en: The practice in which a person who wants to understand part of a codebase asks the agent to write an explainer for exactly that part. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой человек, желающий понять часть кодовой базы, просит агента написать объяснение именно этой части. [1]

sources.quote: When someone wants to understand a part of the codebase, they ask Claude to write an explainer for exactly that slice.
sources.author: Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang

definition.en: The practice in which verbose reading such as file search, logs and test output goes to subagents on a smaller model, while code edits and decisions stay on the main model. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой объёмное чтение, например поиск файлов, логи и вывод тестов, отдаётся субагентам на младшей модели, а правки кода и решения остаются на основной модели. [1][2]

sources.quote: Keep small models on work where a mistake is cheap to spot, like finding files, running tests and reading logs. Keep code edits and judgment calls on the main model.
sources.author: Addy Osmani

sources.quote: Keep the expensive model's context for the decisions, and let cheaper subagents do the verbose reading.
sources.author: Addy Osmani

definition.en: The practice in which the agent is connected to the team's own production traces and asked to find issues on hot code paths, and each resulting pull request links an example trace that shows the extra query or call. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой агента подключают к трейсам продакшена самой команды и просят найти проблемы на горячих участках кода, а каждый итоговый пул-реквест ссылается на пример трейса с лишним запросом или вызовом. [1][2]

sources.quote: I connected my agent (in this case Claude with Opus 5.5) to the Sentry MCP, pointed it at our own Sentry org and project, and asked it to find hot code path issues similar to a small performance PR I had drafted:
sources.author: Scott Cooper

sources.quote: Every PR links an example trace showing the extra query or call, so that it's a bit easier for a reviewer to understand.
sources.author: Scott Cooper

title.ru: База только для чтения для агента

definition.en: The practice in which the agent has access to a read-only copy of the database and validates its query changes there instead of guessing their effect. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой у агента есть доступ к копии базы данных только для чтения, и он проверяет на ней свои изменения запросов, а не угадывает их эффект. [1]

sources.quote: Making sure the agent has the ability to validate changes in the read-only database rather than guessing leads to much better results.
sources.author: Scott Cooper

title.ru: Запись бага до и после исправления

definition.en: The practice in which, for a bug fix, the agent reproduces the issue, records the broken behavior, implements the fix and repeats the same steps to show the before and after; the team keeps the instructions for this in a skill. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой для исправления бага агент воспроизводит проблему, записывает сломанное поведение, вносит исправление и повторяет те же шаги, чтобы показать «до» и «после»; инструкции для этого команда держит в скилле. [1][2]

sources.quote: For bug fixes, River can reproduce the issue, record the broken behavior, implement the fix, and then repeat the same steps to show the before and after.
sources.author: Michael Garfinkle, Mauricio de Meirelles, David Cortes

sources.quote: So we created a skill to teach agents how to test their changes and prove their work.
sources.author: Michael Garfinkle, Mauricio de Meirelles, David Cortes

definition.en: The practice in which a team keeps a pool of prepared machines for agents, with the main branch checked out, tools installed, apps built and caches warm, so that an agent claims one instead of waiting for setup. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой команда держит пул подготовленных машин для агентов: основная ветка выкачана, инструменты установлены, приложения собраны, кэши прогреты, и агент берёт готовую машину вместо ожидания настройки. [1]

sources.quote: So, instead of preparing a Mac after a request arrives, we switched to keeping a pool of warm Macs at the ready: main checked out (no small feat, as our monorepo is massive), tools installed, apps built, and caches warm.
sources.author: Michael Garfinkle, Mauricio de Meirelles, David Cortes

definition.en: The practice in which long-running tasks are started in terminal panes, such as tmux panes, that the agent observes in real time, instead of the agent sleeping or setting timeouts while it waits. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой долгие задачи запускаются в панелях терминала, например tmux, за которыми агент следит в реальном времени, вместо того чтобы засыпать или ставить таймауты в ожидании. [1]

sources.quote: And instead of sleeping or setting timeouts for the Mac to finish long-running tasks, we used tmux panes that River could observe in real time.
sources.author: Michael Garfinkle, Mauricio de Meirelles, David Cortes

definition.en: The practice in which automated agent workflows run overnight without anyone starting them, pick up bugs, implement and test fixes, and open pull requests that are ready for review the next morning. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой автоматические процессы с агентом работают ночью без ручного запуска: берут баги, реализуют и тестируют исправления и открывают пул-реквесты, готовые к ревью утром. [1]

sources.quote: Some of these run overnight, automatically picking up bugs, implementing fixes, testing them, and creating PRs.
sources.author: Michael Garfinkle, Mauricio de Meirelles, David Cortes

definition.en: The practice in which every fact the agent extracts from legacy code carries a file:line reference back to that code. [1]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой каждый факт, извлечённый агентом из унаследованного кода, несёт ссылку file:line на этот код. [1]

sources.quote: Source traceability is the real anti-hallucination mechanism. Every extracted fact carries a file:line reference back to the legacy code.
sources.author: Shashank Mishra

definition.en: The practice in which every fact the agent extracts from legacy code carries a green, amber or red confidence marker, and ambiguous code is flagged in the output so that a human expert resolves it. [1][2]
definition.ru: Практика, при которой каждый факт, извлечённый агентом из унаследованного кода, несёт зелёную, жёлтую или красную метку уверенности, а неоднозначный код отмечается в выводе, чтобы его разрешил эксперт. [1][2]

sources.quote: To achieve this, every extracted fact carried a green, amber or red confidence marker.
sources.author: Shashank Mishra

sources.quote: One was that if the code was ambiguous, the AI had to flag the ambiguity in its output so a human expert could resolve it.
sources.author: Shashank Mishra
